Comment scanner tout un paquet ?: How do I scan a whole pile?
Dans le scan, active <b>Auto</b> (en bas: In the scan, turn on Auto (bottom right): place the cards one after another, name in the strip; each one is added as soon as its name is read twice in a row, without touching the screen; take it away (or show the next one) to continue. Editions: pick the first card's, the next ones take it if they exist in the scan's sets; a card from another set asks you for its own. For a deck or a binder, the scan settings let you choose everything at the end, looking at the artwork (or scan without editions). Only one language in the pile? Set it in the settings, it's faster.
